title: How many words a lesson teaches
statement: How many words a lesson should teach in depth, one or a few, is not settled.
example: A simulated review found three lessons teaching one new word each, below a two-to-three rule.
detail: A decisions log records that the rule pack sets exactly one taught word per lesson (`grade3-reading/artifacts/DECISIONS-2026-08-24.md`). A simulated review found three lessons with one new word each, below the wiki's own rule of two to three academic (Tier-2) words per lesson, and called it an open, unresolved conflict, downgraded to a note on adversarial check (`grade3-reading/artifacts/arc-audit/SIM-REVIEW-D1-D4.md`).
